periods.time: Final selection day, immediately before Ikki's match

name.zh: 史黛菈三秒取胜并鼓励一辉
name.en: Stella Wins in Three Seconds and Encourages Ikki

periods.summary: Stella rushes from her own final match after winning in three seconds, shows Ikki her representative medal, and tells him to win so they can climb to the knight summit together.
periods.cause: Stella wants to fulfill her promise and give Ikki courage before his decisive battle.
periods.process: She ends her match at record speed, runs to the gate, and declares that she has become a Seven Stars representative as promised.
periods.outcome: Ikki changes his farewell from 'I'll go and come back' to 'I'll bring victory back.'
periods.significance: Completes Stella's active answer to the scandal and provides Ikki the final emotional push.
